scope.project: Committed Paper product roadmap including customer readiness; optional Live excluded.
scope.prototype: One owner, one Bot, one supported Pine, BTCUSDT Spot 1m, existing 10K-bar profile. Excludes full portfolio/export/email, broader multi-Pine, paid launch and Live.

allocationRule: Equal shares among explicitly bounded outcomes within each fixed PM-1 category. This is a planning convention, not measured labor; frozen before credits and totals. No weighting adjustment to match historical estimates.
environmentRule: Targets follow original packet scope: delivered staging baselines stay staging; explicitly local engineering/diagnostic packets stay local; production rollout is a distinct F12-04 outcome. Local completion does not close release acceptance.
doubleCountingRule: A project outcome appears once. Cross-view references do not add weights across views. Prototype P06-01 covers storage/reopening; P06-03 covers comparison/refusal behavior, distinct outcomes supported by the same Library package. Infrastructure references create no bonus points.

categories.label: Owner identity, Bot lifecycle and shared Web UI

deliverables.outcome: Owner authentication and tenant-scoped access
deliverables.acceptance: Authenticated access, CSRF and owner isolation are implemented, independently checked and read back in staging.

deliverables.outcome: Bot creation and lifecycle
deliverables.acceptance: An authenticated owner creates a Bot and uses its supported lifecycle without bypassing capacity or readiness gates.

deliverables.outcome: Shared UI and journey visibility
deliverables.acceptance: The shared desktop/mobile UI reports supported, disabled and unavailable steps accurately.

categories.label: Single-Pine registry, AI Bridge, binding and transport

deliverables.outcome: Single-Pine registry, AI generation and guide
deliverables.acceptance: A real generation produces the supported source-bound Bridge and guide with reviewed compile and registry identity.

deliverables.outcome: Ten-input selection and round-trip
deliverables.acceptance: Eight selected source inputs plus ATR/RR round-trip through UI, generation and immutable snapshot with coherent deployment/research selection. Effects are scored separately in F05.

deliverables.outcome: Versioned authenticated transport and scoped targeting
deliverables.acceptance: The exact Bridge reaches the receiver with owner, Bot and entry identity; duplicate and unrelated targets are refused. Paper accounting is scored in F03.

categories.label: Paper execution, risk, allocation and ledger correctness

deliverables.outcome: Paper risk decisions, allocation and targeted EXIT baseline
deliverables.acceptance: Accepted, capped and rejected entries and reduce-only exits reconcile with scoped Paper allocations and ledger evidence.

deliverables.outcome: O3/G1/F4 accounting corrections
deliverables.acceptance: Reviewed exit-cost, unlotted FIFO and funding-fence corrections are integrated with their bounded tests; deployment is a separate F12 outcome.

deliverables.outcome: Worker transient faults, bounded rejection and systemic hold
deliverables.acceptance: The W1 worker behavior is integrated and read back in staging within its provisional policy; long observation and production release are separate F12 gates.

deliverables.outcome: Database transaction and runtime lease integrity
deliverables.acceptance: Late queued SQL is refused and runtime leases enforce origin, preserve failures and retain the maintenance lock; applicable verification and integration are complete.

deliverables.outcome: Tracked script and source writer guard
deliverables.acceptance: The structural guard covers the specified tracked JS/MJS/SQL writer inventory and exact import exceptions; no SQL-parser or dynamic-SQL safety claim.

deliverables.outcome: Spot ingestion and bounded BACKFILL provenance
deliverables.acceptance: One bounded supported raw-data capture/backfill is durable and bound to its declared source, interval and cutoff.

deliverables.outcome: Prototype charts and market-data diagnostics
deliverables.acceptance: The supported chart and indicators display current/stale/limited states accurately at prototype scale; production scaling is F12.

deliverables.outcome: PF-2 historical Preflight
deliverables.acceptance: Trusted resolution, historical replay and evidence publication complete on the supported admitted profile.

deliverables.outcome: PF-3 readiness report
deliverables.acceptance: Capability-scoped readiness reports blockers and provenance without converting unavailable historical evidence into readiness.

deliverables.outcome: PF-4 deterministic Risk proposals
deliverables.acceptance: Preview/save uses a bound current policy, read-only preview and explicit owner confirmation; running-state refusal remains enforced.

categories.label: Evaluator, selected-input parity and validation semantics

deliverables.outcome: Supported source evaluator baseline
deliverables.acceptance: The source-bound evaluator and serial Paper decisions match the retained supported TradingView/Node/Python baseline.

deliverables.outcome: Selected-input empirical parity and supported effects
deliverables.acceptance: All owner-selected source dimensions and ATR/RR meet the declared effects/parity criteria or an explicitly approved contract revision.

deliverables.outcome: Cost, chronological validation and holdout semantics
deliverables.acceptance: Costs, chronological partitions and untouched holdout rules produce an honest terminal qualification status, including NO_VALID_CANDIDATE.

deliverables.outcome: Immutable research jobs, progress and cancellation
deliverables.acceptance: Owner-scoped source/input/data/policy snapshots, durable progress, cancellation and terminal readback survive supported recovery.

deliverables.outcome: Bounded optimizer execution and terminal outcome
deliverables.acceptance: One admitted supported job searches its declared dimensions within budget and records a durable terminal outcome; profitability is not required.

deliverables.outcome: Legacy optimize request and transaction containment
deliverables.acceptance: The legacy proxy has a reviewed bounded request/transaction lifetime with honest unknown outcomes and no unsafe automatic retry.

categories.label: Recovery, isolation, accounting and R7 capacity

deliverables.outcome: W7 recovery and D6 diagnostic admission prerequisites
deliverables.acceptance: The bounded recovery windows and D6 prerequisite checks are reviewed with preserved unsuccessful attempts.

deliverables.outcome: R7 J1-J4 scheduler and resource-accounting cases
deliverables.acceptance: The named J1-J4 package scopes and their source reconciliation are accepted; this does not establish wider capacity.

deliverables.outcome: EM2 measurement controller and recovery tooling
deliverables.acceptance: The native chain, lineage, persistence, held-lock reporting and recovery matrix have accepted local evidence.

deliverables.outcome: Fresh R7 capacity measurement and qualification
deliverables.acceptance: A fresh admitted measurement epoch closes the declared workload/capacity gates with reviewed runtime evidence.

deliverables.outcome: Owner-scoped Library storage and inspection
deliverables.acceptance: Preserved terminal runs reopen with source/input/data/policy provenance and explicit unavailable metrics.

deliverables.outcome: QR-1b durable artifact freeze
deliverables.acceptance: Terminal artifacts and parents are protected against the specified mutations and verified after restart/restore in the target release.

categories.label: Validated Best Inputs, delivery and owner handoff

deliverables.outcome: Qualified Best Inputs package and validation
deliverables.acceptance: A source-bound candidate package passes the QL-4B/QL-4C compile, provenance and validation gates before being exposed as a recommendation.

deliverables.outcome: Export and matching email report delivery
deliverables.acceptance: The validated export and matching report pass the delivery/SMTP gates without exposing an unqualified recommendation.

deliverables.outcome: Explicit review, import and owner handoff
deliverables.acceptance: The owner reviews a compatible validated package and explicitly imports or starts a new Bot; no automatic apply or optimizer loop.

categories.label: Portfolio, full fair comparison and selection

deliverables.outcome: QR-2 actual Paper portfolio performance
deliverables.acceptance: A complete portfolio view reconciles actual Paper history, valuation and costs for the declared range.

deliverables.outcome: QR-3 full fair comparison
deliverables.acceptance: Complete declared-period comparisons enforce compatible data, policy, cost and validation contexts.

deliverables.outcome: QR-4 qualified best-performance selection
deliverables.acceptance: Selection distinguishes development scores from qualified recommendations and refuses unsupported rankings.

deliverables.outcome: Multi-Pine contracts and evaluator/package compatibility
deliverables.acceptance: Multiple registered sources use the declared shared Bridge pair and source-bound evaluation/package rules without owner-facing activation.

deliverables.outcome: APP-3B multi-Pine Paper isolation and canary
deliverables.acceptance: Shared-symbol allocations, reservations, exits, workload and recovery pass the declared cross-Bot and oversell acceptance gates.

categories.label: Production scaling and customer launch readiness

deliverables.outcome: MD-1 production market-data scaling
deliverables.acceptance: Shared-IP market load is separated and budgeted under the MD-1 operational acceptance criteria.

deliverables.outcome: Customer lifecycle, quotas and entitlement
deliverables.acceptance: The APP-4 customer lifecycle and entitlement/quotas pass the bounded customer Paper beta contract.

deliverables.outcome: Customer security and launch operations
deliverables.acceptance: Customer-scale security and operational acceptance are documented and verified beyond the existing single-owner staging baseline.

deliverables.outcome: Reviewed Paper production rollout and observation
deliverables.acceptance: Release identity, dependency closure, rollback and required observations pass before the production Paper correction is accepted.

deliverables.outcome: Generate the supported Bridge and guide
deliverables.acceptance: A real supported-source AI generation yields the compiled/reviewed artifact and usable guide.

deliverables.outcome: Ten-input round-trip and coherent selection
deliverables.acceptance: The eight selected slots and two Bridge values round-trip without truncation or selection drift.

deliverables.outcome: Effects and parity of the selected dimensions
deliverables.acceptance: Each selected dimension meets its supported-effect and empirical parity criterion.

deliverables.outcome: Historical Preflight on an admitted supported profile
deliverables.acceptance: An admitted historical run supplies trusted capability-scoped evidence.

deliverables.outcome: Readiness with honest historical status
deliverables.acceptance: Readiness reflects actual provenance and unavailable gates.

deliverables.outcome: Policy-bound Risk preview and save
deliverables.acceptance: The owner can preview and explicitly save an eligible proposal with current policy provenance.

categories.label: TradingView transport and reconciled Paper execution

deliverables.outcome: Real same-entry TradingView BUY and targeted EXIT
deliverables.acceptance: A natural same-entry pair reaches the exact owner/Bot/deployment with durable receipt identity.

deliverables.outcome: Paper risk, isolation and ledger reconciliation
deliverables.acceptance: The pair reconciles with reduce-only allocation/ledger behavior and independent duplicate/cap/isolation controls.

deliverables.outcome: Snapshot, progress, cancel and durable result controls
deliverables.acceptance: The user sees bound immutable inputs, progress/cancel and durable terminal status.

deliverables.outcome: Current profile capacity and admission
deliverables.acceptance: Required admission/capacity gates for this supported profile are closed.

deliverables.outcome: One bounded supported terminal run
deliverables.acceptance: One admitted run executes the declared search and preserves its honest terminal result; NO_VALID_CANDIDATE is valid.

deliverables.outcome: Reopen and inspect preserved runs
deliverables.acceptance: Completed, failed and other terminal outcomes retain owner and research provenance when reopened.

deliverables.outcome: Artifact durability and freeze
deliverables.acceptance: The declared immutable artifacts survive restart/restore and retain truthful freeze status.

deliverables.outcome: Minimal compatible comparison and qualification display
deliverables.acceptance: Incompatible contexts withhold metrics; no qualified winner is shown without evidence. Full QR-3/QR-4 and export are excluded.
